comment: Exceptions to the helix-lint preset (#559). Every entry needs `files` (globs), `rules` and a `reason`; helixAllow throws without one and so fails `pnpm lint`. One entry per file and rule, no directory globs. Remove an entry when its file migrates. Stylelint rules and `helix/no-raw-control` are listed under their own key.

stylelint.reason: The chart series colors (--c-baseline, --c-load, --c-carry, --c-follow) are literals because Helix has no chart tokens (decision of #557)
The status bar of the shell is 28px high: `:host ::ng-deep button` sets its hx-button children to 24px so they stay inside it
